interactive_browser_handoff.title: Browser is ready — switch to the window to sign in
interactive_browser_handoff.guidance_l1: This platform has no web QR sign-in flow; the backend has launched a headed Chromium on the host machine.
interactive_browser_handoff.guidance_l2: In the popup window, complete Google account + 2FA in the order guided by the platform.
interactive_browser_handoff.guidance_l3: No button click needed after — the backend watches login state and saves the cookie automatically.
interactive_browser_handoff.cta_label: Backend is waiting on the headed Chrome sign-in · auto-cancels after 5 minutes
interactive_browser_handoff.timeout_label: 5-minute timeout reached, this authorization was cancelled
